main_text.l: lumen, Sebastianum Benefildum, Ioannem Prideaux, Theologos celebres, & totum de-nique Academici ordinis chorum?

Sed quo delabor? Aperietur nobis alius de his dicendi campus. Tu nunc, mi frater, li-bellum hunc, veteris & indubitati mei in te amoris tesseram cape, & prosperein Do-mino age. Heidelbergæ II. Se-ptembr. 1616.
